body:
Hi David,
FYI: Attached is an email Beatrice issued last night following our phone 
call yesterday afternoon. I am going to follow up with her today.

סוקו <Keren.Nahir100@gmail.com <mailto:Keren.Nahir100@gmail.com> >

הי גלעד,

קיימנו אתמול בערב ישיבת סטטוס ואני רוצה לשתף אותך בעיקרי הדברים:
1. מארזי 12 לפעילות סוף שנה - העברנו מייל מסודר למפעל עם שאלות לגבי 
ההיתכנות, לוגיסטיקה, תמחור וכו' - נעדכן במידה והכיוון חיובי ונכנס לעבודת 
גרפיקה זריזה על מנת לבצע התאמות לדרישות הרגולציה הנדרשת בקוריאה.
2. בנוסף, שוב במידה והכיוון חיובי, ההמלצה שלנו על מנת לנסות לעמוד בלוח זמנים 
קצר, להתקדם עם 3 הסוגים: סטרס, אנרגיה ומערכת חיסונית - 2 יחידות מכל סוג 
במארז שישייה *2 מארזים מחוברים ביניהם.
3. במקביל נעבוד על דוגמאות של 3 סוגים חדשים: מלטונין,  PMS(זעפרן), ונוטרי 
קוסמטיקס. אנו נבדוק כמות מינימום ומחירים לייצור דוגמאות ללא מארזים ולצרכי 
טעימה בלבד ולאחר מכן נעדכן מה נדרש מהלקוח על מנת לעזור במימון.
4. הסכם התקשרות - נכין מסמך קצר ופשוט עד כמה שניתן על מנת להקל על חתימה 
זריזה ולהתקדם לייצור.

זמינה לכל שאלה נוספת,
ביאטריס
  <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKMXOmaFH7nJrUmVsBZSJ9vlTy1iE47ZJCmirQ2Hsgq2u9NjF42Qg=s80-p>

Boker Tov,

I hope I am missing something here.

1. I still see 7.3 Euro for 5,000 Units in the Exel file attached word file 
that Ilan sent and Ilan changed the payment term from 30%, 40, 30% to 50%, 
50%.

New Terms

ﾷ 50% of the total order value is due within 30 days (net 30) from the date 
of order confirmation.

ﾷ 50% is due upon delivery of the goods

Old Terms

Credit terms:

ﾷ 30% with the order

ﾷ 30% - 30 days from delivery day

ﾷ 40% - 55 days from delivery day

The payment terms were already delivered to Nlize. It wouldn't seem 
professional and even right to change it now.

BTW, I didn't send the price list yet.

In order to finalize the deal with Nlize, Zenlife should come up with better 
conditions. As far as I see Zenlife has nothing but the deal with Nlize in 
order to "survive".

2. Agreement

As you know well, reviewing the terms and conditions of agreement takes long 
time. It will be appreciated if you can "push" Zenlife to send the agreement 
ASAP, even if it's a draft.

3. Package Catalog

Can you ask Ilan to send the package catalog he showed yesterday on the Zoom 
meeting? Also, it will be appreciated to let us know what the mini-tablets 
and Napolitains are exactly and the size of each. BTW, I let Nlize know 
about the message from the factory and I suggested them to go with 6 pieces.

It seems I should start having longer time of meditation "thanks to 
Zenlife".

Let's get our first deal done.

היי גלעד,

ראה מייל התכתבות בינך לבין קרן מתאריך 20.05.2025
שים לב בפסקה האחרונה, שקרן מדברת על שני מקרי קיצון של רכישה,

האחת בכמות קטנה של 300 יח, והשנייה לכמות של  25000 יחידות.
לשני מקרי הקיצון הללו יש שתי עמודות נפרדות בקובץ האקסל:
עמודה H: עבור הכמויות הקטנות מופיע אצל קרן במחיר של 9 יורו באריזה החודשית 
ומחיר של 0.95 יורו ל 1SHOT, בקובץ המחירון שנשלח אליך היום בעמודה H מופיעים 
מחירים של  8.80 יורו למארז החודשי, ו0.7 יורו ל 1SHOT (בכמות גדולה יותר מזו 
שקרן שלחה מכיוון שלמדנו שאין אפשרות לכמות קטנה יותר).

בנוסף, הובטחה הנחה נוספת של 5% עבור שתי ההזמנות הראשונות ועבור הזמנת 1000 
יחידות מהאריזה החודשית (במקום 300 יח) הוצעה הנחה נוספת של 5% נוספים.

body:
Jasmine,

We received your mail and attached agreement with surprise and 
disappointment:

1. We all, and especially David's team in Korea, invest time and efforts for 
the pilot to be successful. All this is done without any clear and binding 
agreement between us, let alone no agreed upon commercial terms. The pilot 
began based on mutual trust and the knowledge that there is some sort of an 
agreement  between Ran and Belle that does not necessarily apply here.
2. The content and language of the attached agreement and the repeated 
demand for subscription fees (section 2.1) - tells us good faith remains the 
property of our side only.
3. Also, the untimely sending of this proposal for agreement, several weeks 
into the pilot, is completely unacceptable. Had you raised this demand for 
an agreement prior to the start of the pilot we would have also asked for a 
detailed and full commercial agreement.

At this point we hold any further advancement of the pilot until one of the 
two:

1. You withdraw from your demand for the attached agreement.
2. We go for a  full agreement that also determines the scope of our 
relations and commercial terms.

Subsequently, if you find that you cannot accept and respect the above, we 
will call this pilot immediately off.

Kind regards,
Gilad

subject: Re: Kotra Tel Aviv - YAKIN / ORCHESTA
body:
Dear Chase,

Sorry for taking some time to evaluate and think over the matter at hand.

Generally speaking, Israel is a relatively small market and when it comes to 
fashion manufacturing - it is really small.  In the past two decades most, 
if not all, as far as my knowledge goes, large Israeli fashion manufacturing 
companies switched from manufacturing to importing. You may still find very 
few larger local manufacturers but they deal with underwear and T-shirts 
made of 100% cotton or at least 60-65% cotton.  So the market is basically 
limited today to about 50 established (yet relatively small) fashion 
designers that buy from local garments wholesalers.

Having said the above, a 6000 yards purchase seems to be substantial but 
possible for some local wholesalers.

What we can offer to you:

1. A market study, using both online and offline sources and interviews that 
will aim to estimate with high certainty - market size and possible annual 
sales volume that Yakin can achieve in Israel.  Cost of this research would 
be US$6,000+VAT.
2.  If research results suggest that it is attractive for Yakin to enter the 
market - we will work on a success basis = percent from sales volume.

Lastly - a clarification - Mr. David Park is my Korean partner and Yogibo is 
a company he owns and manages in Korea. David himself knows the Israeli 
market pretty well and spent some 15 years in Israel. Every Korean client of 
Orchesta is also a client of David and Yogibo.

Thank you and look forward to hearing what may suit you best.

Kind regards,
Gilad

subject: Hello from Israel
body:
Shalom David,

How are you doing?
As you are surely well aware, we have had some tough times in the last 18 
months. I think we are still in the "digestion" phase of all that happened.

I am happy to approach you again and this time about options to bring Korean 
retail labels to Israel. I would focus on cosmetics, apparel, health food 
and lifestyle.  Since you have deep knowledge of both markets, l would 
appreciate very much hearing from you of prominent brands in these sectors 
that you think have potential to succeed in Israel.

I still have the vision that we both can build a successful business 
involving Korea  and Israel.

Hope to hear from you soon and meanwhile I extend to you my warmest wishes.

Gilad
